author: claude
task:
We charge a flat $7.99 for shipping, which loses money on heavy and remote orders and overcharges small local ones. Replace it with the carrier's real rate.

Interface (the label-buying service will call `quoteShipping` directly):
- New module `src/shipping.ts` exporting `quoteShipping(parcel: Parcel, destinationZip: string): Quote`, where `Parcel` is the existing type from `src/packaging.ts` and `interface Quote { zone: number; billableGrams: number; amountCents: number }`.
- `amountCents` is what the carrier will charge us for the parcel, which is what we pass on to the customer.
- Export `class ShippingError extends Error`, thrown when a parcel cannot be quoted (bad or unknown ZIP, or a parcel the carrier will not accept).
- `checkoutTotal(lines, destinationZip)` in `src/checkout.ts` takes the destination ZIP as a new second argument and charges the quote for `parcelFor(lines)` instead of the flat fee.

Zones and prices come from `data/zones.json` and `data/rates.json`.

requirements.text: Billable weight is the greater of actual weight and dimensional weight (L×W×H cm / 5000 kg): a 2 kg parcel of 40×30×20 cm bills as 5 kg.
Billable weight rounds up to the next 0.5 kg: 1001 g bills as 1500 g.
The longest matching ZIP prefix decides the zone, so Hawaii (967), Alaska (995) and Puerto Rico (006) get zone 8 rather than their one-digit regional zone, regardless of entry order in zones.json.
requirements.clue: README.md data/zones.json note; overlapping prefixes in data/zones.json

requirements.text: The amount includes the fuel surcharge from rates.json, rounded to the nearest cent with halves up (570 cents + 7.5% = 613).
Parcels over 30 kg actual weight or with any side over 150 cm throw ShippingError; parcels exactly at the limits are accepted.
Orders at or above FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD_CENTS still ship free to every destination.
